LanguageData.Raven_Building_PatternFloor_A.label: [Raven] Pattern Floor A
LanguageData.Raven_Building_PatternFloor_A.descriptio: A 3x3 decorative patterned floor tile, style A. It greatly enhances the beauty of the environment.
LanguageData.Raven_Building_PatternFloor_B.label: [Raven] Pattern Floor B
LanguageData.Raven_Building_PatternFloor_B.descriptio: A 3x3 decorative patterned floor tile, style B. It greatly enhances the beauty of the environment.
LanguageData.Raven_Building_PatternFloor_C.label: [Raven] Pattern Floor C
LanguageData.Raven_Building_PatternFloor_C.descriptio: A 3x3 decorative patterned floor tile, style C. It greatly enhances the beauty of the environment.
LanguageData.Raven_Building_HotSpringTileHorizontal.d: A hot spring stone border placed along the edge of a cell. Plan continuous runs like walls and rotate it to select the top, right, bottom, or left side. Stack two differently rotated borders in the same cell to form a mitered corner. It does not create hot spring terrain on its own.
An outer corner that joins two hot spring divider tiles. Rotation automatically selects artwork with the correct upper or lower thickness, and it can share a cell with other hot spring tiles.
LanguageData.Raven_Building_HotSpringSpout.label: [Raven] Hot Spring Spout
LanguageData.Raven_Building_HotSpringSpout.descriptio: A decorative circulation spout for Raven fluid hot springs. Its flow is always visible, it can face any of four directions, and it does not create hot spring terrain.
LanguageData.Raven_Building_HotSpringDecorationOne.de: A neatly arranged set of towels, bathing supplies, and care bottles. It can be built directly over Raven fluid hot spring terrain.
LanguageData.Raven_Building_HotSpringDecorationTwo.de: A flower-filled bathing bucket draped with a towel. It can be built directly over Raven fluid hot spring terrain.
A long-handled bath ladle with unique artwork for all four directions. It can be built directly over Raven fluid hot spring terrain.
LanguageData.Raven_DoorSlopeSingle.label: [Raven] Door Threshold (Single)
LanguageData.Raven_DoorSlopeSingle.description: A smooth transitional slope threshold. Designed to be placed right under a single door, it will never obstruct pawn movement and slightly improves the room's beauty.
LanguageData.Raven_DoorSlopeDouble.label: [Raven] Door Threshold (Double)
LanguageData.Raven_DoorSlopeDouble.description: A smooth transitional slope threshold. Designed specifically for double doors, it will never obstruct pawn movement and slightly improves the room's beauty.
LanguageData.Raven_DoorSlopeMassive.label: [Raven] Hangar Door Threshold (Massive)
LanguageData.Raven_DoorSlopeMassive.description: A smooth transitional slope threshold. Designed specifically for massive hangar doors, it will never obstruct pawn movement and slightly improves the room's beauty.
